narration: The framework begins with two input observations, x tau and x tau prime, representing scenes captured at different temporal instances.
A dual-branch Patch Feature Extractor with shared weights passes the inputs through feature encoders and deformable transformer encoders to generate patch tokens.
Guided by the Patch Matching Network, the Multi-Temporal Patch Matching block links corresponding patches across the two time steps.
From the matching results, positive matched pairs and negative distractor patches are categorized into designated patch sets.
The Object Residual Module subtracts learned prototype vectors to construct robust object residual representations.
Finally, the resulting residual features are supervised jointly by multi-view and scale-regression loss functions for end-to-end training.
